# Image element

## Fields {#fields}

Field

Type

Description

Required?

`type`

String

The type of element. In this case `type` is always `image`.

Required

`alt_text`

String

A plain-text summary of the image. This should not contain any markup.

Required

`image_url`

String

The URL for a publicly hosted image. You must provide either an `image_url` or `slack_file`. Maximum length for this field is 3000 characters.

Optional

`slack_file`

Object

A [Slack image file object](https://docs.slack.dev/reference/block-kit/composition-objects/slack-file-object) that defines the source of the image.

Optional

## Usage info {#usage-info}

Use the [`image`](https://docs.slack.dev/reference/block-kit/blocks/image-block) block if you want a block with _only_ an image in it.
